description: The user's film orders (buy and rent), newest first, one row per order: film, purchase or rental, price before tax, the payment processor's fee (processor_fee_estimated is true until the real fee is known; it comes off the price first), Vidreno's 10% cut of what is left after that fee, paid or refunded, what was credited and what the order is worth in the balance today (net: 0 once refunded), and dates. Never includes who bought. Filter by film_id (public film id) or status; paginate with page/page_size. Read-only.

film_id.description: Only this film's orders (a public film id from list_films).

status.description: Only paid orders, only refunded ones, or every order.

name: list_film_sales
title: Film sales
